process_isolation.ancestor_rule: the self PID must exist and exact PPID edges must form a complete acyclic chain ending at PID 1; every ancestor requires a well-formed nonempty opaque raw_comm and lexical_basename, but no positive ancestor identity allowlist or filesystem identity match exists
process_isolation.conflict_rule: exact frozen raw_comm and/or exact lexical_basename deny-set membership; no substring, prefix, suffix, argv, source, payload, filesystem, or symlink matching
process_isolation.discovery_policy: read-only observation/refusal; raw snapshots are classified in memory and retained as exact SHA-256/byte-count/structural receipts; discovered PIDs never enter signal APIs
process_isolation.lexical_basename_semantics: derived only as raw_comm.rsplit('/', 1)[-1], recorded separately, and never resolved, normalized, statted, or checked against the filesystem
process_isolation.malformed_rule: invalid UTF-8, truncation, malformed PID/PPID/remaining-comm structure, control-bearing or empty raw_comm or lexical basename, duplicate PIDs, self-parent edges, missing ancestor parents, ancestor cycles, non-PID1 ppid0, and absent self PID fail closed
process_isolation.raw_comm_semantics: the complete remaining comm field is a nonempty exact opaque process-table string; slashless, slash-bearing, space-bearing, and path-like strings are valid and never filesystem-canonicalized
process_isolation.refusal_diagnostic: bounded libwebp-backref-cost-aligned-null-stage-attribution-v4-process-refusal-v1 object in the integrity footer with failure_code, PID, PPID, raw_comm, lexical_basename, is_ancestor, is_conflict, and SHA-256; no argv, environment, source, payload, command, or filesystem identity
process_isolation.scope_rule: every process row is checked for exact denied raw_comm or lexical_basename membership; arbitrary well-formed non-denied ancestors and nonancestors pass, including slash, spaces, path-like values, and benign lexical collisions
